headline: Cloudflare Shares Rally Following Strong Quarterly Revenue Growth
summary: Cloudflare shares surged after the company posted its fastest sales increase in nearly four years, driven by rising demand for automated AI protection.
why: Cloudflare is a major cloud platform providing web infrastructure, security, and content delivery services, making its revenue growth a key indicator of enterprise spending on digital security and AI applications.

impacts.name: Cloudflare
impacts.why: Stronger sales growth and AI security demand drove the company's stock price higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Faster-than-expected revenue growth and heightened demand for AI protection products improved investor sentiment and drove up the stock price.
